cases.question: 2018年各州销售额前三的商品
cases.reference_sql: WITH state_product_gmv AS (SELECT c.state AS state, i.product_id AS product_id, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM fact_order_item AS i JOIN fact_order AS o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN dim_customer AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.purchase_date >= '2018-01-01' AND o.purchase_date < '2019-01-01' AND o.status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.state, i.product_id), ranked AS (SELECT state, product_id, gmv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY gmv DESC, product_id ASC) AS rank_position FROM state_product_gmv) SELECT state, product_id, gmv, rank_position FROM ranked WHERE rank_position <= 3 ORDER BY state ASC, rank_position ASC

cases.question: 2018年每个州GMV最高的两个品类
cases.reference_sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT region_id, category_id, SUM(gmv) AS metric_value FROM dws_sales_category_daily WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20180101 AND 20181231 GROUP BY region_id, category_id), ranked AS (SELECT region_id, category_id, metric_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_id ORDER BY metric_value DESC, category_id ASC) AS rank_position FROM grouped) SELECT region_id, category_id, metric_value, rank_position FROM ranked WHERE rank_position <= 2 ORDER BY region_id ASC, rank_position ASC

cases.question: 2018年每个州商品项数最少的两个品类
cases.reference_sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT region_id, category_id, SUM(item_count) AS metric_value FROM dws_sales_category_daily WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20180101 AND 20181231 GROUP BY region_id, category_id), ranked AS (SELECT region_id, category_id, metric_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_id ORDER BY metric_value ASC, category_id ASC) AS rank_position FROM grouped) SELECT region_id, category_id, metric_value, rank_position FROM ranked WHERE rank_position <= 2 ORDER BY region_id ASC, rank_position ASC
